structured.approach: I followed the data-science-steps DS-01 procedure. I read both inputs: feat.tasks, to find the lane's repository and tasks, and org.engineering_stack, for the stack, CI and Databricks facts. The step's hook blocks shell commands, so I checked the repository by reading git metadata (HEAD, branch refs, reflog, config) and key files (ci.py, __init__.py, README, CLAUDE.md) with Read and Glob. I used the brief's tool:repo-access view as the authority for write access and the clean working tree. I wrote task.repo_access with the availability, branch and access, Databricks and database, and per-task readiness checks, plus two non-blocking observations.

claims.text: The Data Science lane works in repository ap_forecast, on tasks TSK-03 (STORY-03, vendor_risk) and TSK-04 (STORY-04, risk parameter on build_explanation_request).
Repository ap_forecast is available locally, and the agent identity has write access; git status is clean.
The checked-out branch is feature/story, created from dev at d67e866; dev and main point to the same commit.
No repository creation is needed; the origin remote points to GitHub repository arghya05/ap-forecast-sample.
No Databricks workspace or database is used by ap_forecast.
CI is /usr/bin/python3 ci.py and enforces line coverage of at least 90% plus static checks standing in for SonarQube.
The current ap_forecast version is 0.9.0, which matches feat.tasks section 2.
ci.py imports the third-party package coverage; its installation was not verified, because shell commands are not permitted in DS-01.

open_questions: RA-1 (non-blocking): the working branch is the generic feature/story rather than a story-specific feature/<story>, so TSK-03 and TSK-04 would share it. Confirm this is intended; commit prefixes STORY-03 and STORY-04 keep traceability.
RA-2 (non-blocking): ci.py depends on the third-party coverage package. Confirm it is installed for /usr/bin/python3 when CI first runs (DS-06 or DS-07).
structured.summary: ap_forecast is available locally with write access, on branch feature/story created from dev at d67e866, with a clean working tree. No repository needs to be created, and no Databricks or database is involved. The file paths that TSK-03 and TSK-04 will change are present. task.repo_access is written; there are two non-blocking observations, on the branch name and on the CI coverage package.

tool_input.command: git status -sb && git branch -a && git log --oneline -3 && git remote -v && ls -la && test -w .git && echo WRITABLE
tool_input.description: Check repo branch, remotes, and write access
Show working tree status of ap_forecast
